title: Assign a whole text from its lessons
statement: Assign a whole text part by part from the lessons that use it, since a text left in a reader isn't delivered and opening it isn't reading it.
example: A 27-chapter novel sat in one course's reader, assigned from no lesson, until assignment groups in its lessons 1 to 4 covered every chapter exactly once.
detail: An integration review of a rebuilt Grade 5 unit found the complete novel available in the course's reader but assigned from no lesson, and drew a rule from it: availability is not delivery, so lessons link exact chapter assignments and later revisits, the student's work stays in the lesson, and a bookmark never counts as reading completion (`grade3-reading/visual-findings-2026-09-07/review-readiness/curriculum-alignment/rebuild/methodology/INTEGRATION-LESSONS.md`, line 16). After the repair, assignment groups in lessons 1 to 4 cover chapters 1 to 27 exactly once (`grade3-reading/visual-findings-2026-09-07/review-readiness/curriculum-alignment/rebuild/unit1/INTEGRATED-READINESS-REVIEW.md`, line 33). The restoration plan and the unit's review both say that access to the full text and recorded assignments are no evidence that a student read it, and a passing navigation test checks that the end of a chapter group returns to the lesson rather than recording completion (`grade3-reading/visual-findings-2026-09-07/review-readiness/curriculum-alignment/RESTORATION-PLAN.md`, line 80; `grade3-reading/visual-findings-2026-09-07/review-readiness/curriculum-alignment/rebuild/unit1/INTEGRATED-READINESS-REVIEW.md`, line 38; `grade3-reading/visual-findings-2026-09-07/review-readiness/curriculum-alignment/rebuild/integration/check-before-final-content.txt`, line 689).
against: The integration notes say their rules are inferred from reproducible failures in this one rebuild, and that applying them elsewhere is a production judgment (`grade3-reading/visual-findings-2026-09-07/review-readiness/curriculum-alignment/rebuild/methodology/INTEGRATION-LESSONS.md`, line 30).

evidence.quote: Full-novel text existed but was not assigned from lessons
Availability is not delivery. Link exact chapter assignments and later source revisits, preserve work in the lesson tab, and never count a bookmark as reading completion.
Assignment groups L1–L4 cover Chapters 1–27 exactly once.
This is access to the full text, not proof a student read it. No new mastery claim is inferred from opening a chapter.
Complete source access and recorded assignments are not evidence that a student has finished the novel.
group boundaries return to the lesson rather than inventing reading completion
